info.name: TollBit Auth Tokens Tollbit Content API

description.content:
TollBit is the web stack for the agentic internet: publishers analyze, control, and monetize AI agent access to their content. This API lets developers and AI agents discover licensable content (Licensed Search), fetch rates and license options, mint one-time signed access tokens, retrieve licensed or indexed content, self-report usage, and list a property's content catalog. Reconstructed by API Evangelist from TollBit's published per-operation OpenAPI fragments (docs.tollbit.com/reference).
